evidence: account `vault` is read as state without checking its owner; an attacker can pass a look-alike account
fix: check `vault.owner() == program_id` before reading its data

evidence: account `authority` is checked against a stored authority but never verified as a signer; anyone can pass this address without signing
fix: require `authority.is_signer()` before trusting it as the authority

evidence: account `target` is invoked as a program without checking its key against an expected id; an attacker can point it at malicious code
fix: compare `target.key()` to the expected program id before invoking

evidence: account `vault` is borrowed unchecked without a `data_len()` guard; a shorter account reads past its end
fix: check `vault.data_len() >= size_of::<T>()` before the unchecked borrow

evidence: `PaddedVault` has 7 byte(s) of implicit padding (layout 48 vs packed 41); zero-copy reads won't match its packed borsh form
`NoReprState` derives ShankAccount/ShankType (read zero-copy) but is not #[repr(C)]; the default layout may reorder fields
